rows.en: Right?
Found you!! Yummy!!
Ah...!! Ankh!!
...It's just a hand!? Could that be the one they call Ankh...
...It's just a hand!? Don't tell me that's the Ankh guy...
...It's just a hand!? Could that be this Ankh we heard about...
...It's just a hand!? Could that be the one called Ankh...
Mreeeeeooow!!
Ankh...? Oh, that half-baked reject of a Greeed.
Tch! ...Where'd you get that Yummy? Do you know Kazari!?
Kazari...? Ah, those Greeed... Of course I know them.
They were a fun bunch, y'know? The Siamese Cat Yummy is a parting gift from Kazari.
Monsters born from desire, I hear. I like it.
Mreeeeeooow!!
Rider 1 and Rider 2 both fell prey to this thing. Now, how about you lot?
Now, how about you lot?
All right, Negataros Army!! Let's do this!!
There's a lot of them... OOO!! Use this Core Medal!!
Got it!
You obtained a new Core Medal! OOO can now use new skills.
Obtained the "Rider Pass".
Is this it? The Rider Pass those Imagin were looking for!
Is this it? The Rider Pass those Imagin were looking for!
Is this it? The Rider Pass those Imagin were looking for!
Is this it? The Rider Pass those Imagin were looking for!
Is this it? The Rider Pass those Imagin were looking for!
...Damn it!! But don't think this is over...!!
Farewell!!
...Hsss! Hsss!
That Yummy... It's still alive...!!
...Mrrreeeooow...
Something's lying on the ground!
Wait!!
Ah, Ankh!!
Aw... He's gone.
Ankh chased after the Siamese Cat Yummy and disappeared somewhere.
Hm? There's something on the ground.
This is... a medal from the Yummy that got away?
Hm? There's something on the ground.
This is... a medal from the Yummy that got away?
Hm? There's something on the ground.
This is... a medal from the Yummy that got away?
Hm? There's something on the ground.
This is... a medal from the Yummy that got away?
Hm? There's something on the ground.
This is... from the Yummy that got away...
What was lying there was a Cell Medal.
Obtained a Cell Medal.
Still... putting people in cryogenic storage...
So is the Weather Dopant the one pulling the strings after all...?
Still... putting people in cryogenic storage...
So is the Weather Dopant the one pulling the strings after all...?
Still... putting people in cryogenic storage...
So is the Weather Dopant the one pulling the strings after all...?
Still... putting people in cryogenic storage...
So is the Weather Dopant the one pulling the strings after all...?
Still... putting people in cryogenic storage...
So the one pulling the strings is that Weather Dopant guy after all?
Meanwhile, the Weather Dopant and the others...
Well done, Negataros. Your capture of Kamen Riders 1 and 2 is worthy of praise.
Your capture of Kamen Riders 1 and 2 is worthy of praise.
I'm sure Lord Ikadevil will be delighted as well.
Then let us send them to the "Hideout Cube" at once. ...Is the Ride Machine ready?
Is the Ride Machine ready?
Yes, sir! It will be ready shortly!
Hurry! We must not keep Lord Ikadevil waiting!
...By the way, about those underlings of mine...
I am aware.
I shall prepare stronger pawns, so you can keep working for us to the fullest.
Much obliged. I owe you one.
That leaves only one more. We must capture that one, whatever it takes...
...Hm? The higher-ups told us to get three this time, didn't they?
Yes, that's right. Why?
Rider 1, Rider 2, and Methuss. Don't we have all three already?
Methuss will serve as a subject for my research. For my own personal amusement.
Now then, all of you!
There must be other heroes who've slipped in here. I'm counting on you to capture them!
Hey, Ankh!! Are you with OOO?
Hey, Ankh!! Are you with OOO?
Ankh! Are you a companion of OOO's?

notes.note: No speaker recovered. Sits between Negataros's demand to be frozen and Ankh's entrance; read as a startled reaction to the interruption. Could instead be Negataros's tag 'Right?' if he speaks it.
Same Japanese for W (Philip), Zero, Zeta, Nu (rows 0.79-0.82); meaning kept identical, wording nudged per voice (Zero casual 'the Ankh guy').
Cat shriek rendered 'Mreeeeeooow!!'; the same Japanese appears in story_008 row 0.60, keep consistent there.
'Dekisokonai' (failure/reject) about Ankh, who is only a hand: 'half-baked reject of a Greeed', insult kept at full strength.
'Sono Yummy wo dou shita' read as 'where'd you get that Yummy' (it is Kazari's Yummy), confirmed by Negataros's reply in 0.86-0.87.
'Negataros gundan' rendered 'Negataros Army' (not in glossary; story_008 row 0.66 has the full group name and should match).
No speaker; likely a field prompt before the party-specific lines 0.116-0.125. Rendered neutral.
Ankh referred to as 'he' per glossary (g=m).
Rows 0.116-0.125: no speaker recovered; party-leader variants of the same lines. 0.125 trails off in source (kept).
Speaker-variant rows 0.129-0.138: 'reitou hozon' (cryogenic storage) echoes Negataros's threat in story_008; 'yahari' + wondering form rendered 'after all...?'.
Rows 0.141, 0.144, 0.153 have no speaker; they are alternate/short copies of Weather Dopant's lines (0.141, 0.144) and his reply to Negataros (0.153). Translated to match.
'Nokoru wa ato 1 tai': the remaining target is unnamed; rendered 'that one' to avoid assuming identity or gender.
'Ue' = the higher-ups; Negataros asks Weather Dopant to confirm the quota.
Direction: Weather Dopant asking his grunts -> 'I'm counting on you'.
Rows 0.159-0.161 are a branch where OOO is not in the party (Ankh replies in story_010 'you know OOO?'). 'Nakama' rendered 'with OOO' / 'a companion of OOO's' (Nu Gundam's polite 'kimi').

proofread: sentence-final tag particle with '?' is 'right?', not a startled 'wha'; the script plays Negataros's run as entries 0.65-0.71 and skips this one, so it reads as his cut tag to 'let us freeze you'.

report: 80/80 rows. Uncertain: 0.72 (no speaker, read as startled reaction), 0.110 and 0.116-0.125 (no speaker, neutral), 0.151 (unnamed remaining target). Names not in glossary: 'Negataros Army' (group name), 'Rider Pass' (Den-O term).
